name: Lottie
source: Lottie is one of the 3 dolls that was created by a doll maker many years ago. Lottie has cryokinesis, allowing her to use ice to stop her enemies. She also has healing powers. Along with the other dolls, Lottie rested in the house until Reuben came across the room they slept in. In contrast to Briar, Lottie is more positive and friendly towards Reuben. She wants to help him survive and finally stop Adelaide.
